summary:
Dear Goran, 

 

It has been so long since I wrote you that I do believe it was before we had our baby on July 25th. I will assume you don’t know that his name is Christo­ pher or that he weighs 16 pounds now; pictures of him are herewith enclosed. Taking care of a new baby exhausted us and consumed all our time; I couldn’t complete my editing of the galleys for my new Doubleday novel FLOW MY TEARS, but it’s coming out anyhow next February—their copy editors did the work for me, bless them. As far as the interview goes, I’ve struggled with it but can’t fill in the mumbled garbled sections, except that where it reads “pure ego” it should read “pure evil.” (I presume you have a copy as well as the one you sent me—since we moved to the new apartment every paper of mine is Lost Some­ where in a Carton; I have the interview, but can’t lay my hands on it.) Yes, I read BILLION YEAR SPREE and much appreciated what Aldiss had to say about my work. And I did note the mention of you—and your two specialties. The U.S. slick sf magazine Vertex has published an excellent interview with me in its December #6 issue; if you don’t get Vertex let me know and when the editor sends me some copies I’ll send one on to you. It has great pictures of me with the interview. (I am trying to cover all the news from here as I recall it.) Eliz­ abeth Antebi from French TV came here with a camera crew and interviewed me and Norman Spinrad at Disneyland, 20th Century Fox and Forest Lawn Ceme­ tery. A reporte...
